summary: Soligenix, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to update its at-the-market (ATM) equity offering under an existing Sales Agreement with Rodman Renshaw LLC. The supplement reflects a revised maximum offering amount of $2,956,000 based on the company's public float of $24,511,625, with a 1/3 limit per General Instruction I.B.6 of Form S-3. The filing is a routine shelf takedown update disclosing offering mechanics and risk factors. It does not represent a special situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction.
